scope: Real ModelsScreen with controlled bridge: identity, failure, duplicate actions, keyboard and layout. No provider authentication or game-quality claim.

checks.label: read failure has an explicit retry and does not claim an empty catalog
virtualized rendering is bounded for 150 models
keyboard selection distinguishes providers with the same model id
save uses provider-specific setting and the original API model id
failed refresh retains loaded catalog and selection
pending read marks refresh busy without changing label
partial discovery displays success counts and provider warning
duplicate downloads dispatch once with provider identity
keyboard clear restores the query and focus
keyboard End reaches a virtualized offscreen model with a valid active descendant
narrow workbench has no document overflow
late response after unmount produces no renderer error
